title: Shared telemetry correlation envelope
description: One correlation envelope propagated everywhere by both the sovav-hermes harness and Turnstone instrumentation. Base fields are required on every envelope. The Turnstone extension fields and the harness-origin propagation fields (harness_task_id/harness_run_id) are required on Turnstone-originated events (repo == "turnstone") and must be null when present otherwise. Cross-repo join key: trace_id + correlation_id. In-repo join key: task_id + run_id. Canonical owner: sovav-hermes (turnstone companion plan D8); Turnstone pins a copy at fixtures/telemetry/correlation-envelope.schema.json with a drift test. Do not edit unilaterally; changes flow through the paired plan.

board.description: Board slug of the originating card, e.g. sovav-hermes or turnstone.

task_id.description: Board task id of the card being worked, e.g. t_2731ee50.

run_id.description: Dispatch/run identifier of the emitting run. Hermes run ids are integers; emitters MAY serialize them as strings. Consumers compare run ids as strings.

parent_task_ids.description: Parent card ids of task_id; empty array when the card has no parents.

profile/role.description: Emitting Hermes profile, which is also the role (operator, pm, tm, worker, reviewer). The default/Hermes key is interactive human use only; autonomous spend on it is an attribution red flag.

model.description: Provider-qualified model id as invoked, e.g. z-ai/glm-5.3-flash.

provider.description: Model provider id, e.g. openrouter or anthropic.

key_id.description: NON-SECRET credential label (key name or hash prefix). NEVER a key value.

call_class.description: Call path class of the attributed call.

handoff_id.description: Handoff/transition identifier when the event is part of a handoff; null otherwise.

worktree/branch.description: Git branch the run executed on, identifying the isolated worktree, e.g. r-obs-00.

trace_id.description: Cross-repo trace identifier. One half of the cross-repo join key (trace_id + correlation_id).

repo.description: Marks the event as Turnstone-originated ("turnstone"). Null or absent on harness-originated events.

correlation_id.description: Turnstone correlation identifier. Other half of the cross-repo join key.

idempotency_key.description: Duplicate-export idempotency key; duplicate export of the same agent_run_id + correlation_id is idempotent.

deal_id.description: Opaque internal id (newId("deal")) - safe metadata per companion D2.

trigger_type.description: Run trigger type per the Turnstone trigger policy (automatic triggers stay disabled; production posture 1% manual-only, eval-gated).

runtime_environment.description: From WorkerRunContract.runtime_environment (companion D4); drives the Sentry environment tag.

basis_fingerprint.description: Basis fingerprint; explicitly export-approved metadata (companion D3).

worker_definition_version.description: Version of the worker definition that ran.

output_schema_version.description: Version of the output schema the worker was contract-bound to.

harness_task_id.description: Populated from the TURNSTONE_HARNESS_TASK_ID env var when a Turnstone run originates from a harness card; null otherwise. Carried together with harness_run_id.

harness_run_id.description: Populated from the TURNSTONE_HARNESS_RUN_ID env var when a Turnstone run originates from a harness card; null otherwise. Carried together with harness_task_id.

allOf.$comment: Required-set convention: base fields are always required (top-level required); the Turnstone extension set plus harness_task_id/harness_run_id is additionally required on Turnstone-originated events, where every Turnstone extension field is also narrowed to its non-null type (identifiers must be non-empty; runtime_environment keeps its non-null enum). Off Turnstone the extensions stay nullable/absent; harness_task_id/harness_run_id stay nullable with the pair-consistency rule.
On non-Turnstone (harness-originated) events, every Turnstone extension field and harness propagation field, when present, must be null.
Consistency rule: harness_task_id and harness_run_id are carried together (both non-null or both null).
